build_concept_tree: build a ConceptTree with specified levels, children, and samples per concept for hierarchical concept representation
get_compatible_concepts: get N compatible concepts from the tree excluding specified concepts and optionally filtering leaf nodes only
get_closest_categories: get the closest category pairs by computing pairwise Wu-Palmer similarity between concepts in each category
draw_tree: draw the concept tree as a PyDot graph with optional highlighted concepts colored by group
split_category: split a category into subcategories based on the lowest common ancestor of concepts in the category
